info.name: PayloadPier Supplier Price Compare — RapidAPI
info.description: Compare buyer-supplied supplier price lists. Subscribe to a RapidAPI plan first. Set rapidapi_key locally; never publish it. Each Send uses a new operation key and may incur usage charges. No automatic retries. BASIC includes 3 requests/month. PAYG is $0.30/request; monthly plans and separate bandwidth fees/taxes are shown on RapidAPI. This collection is a downloadable integration example, not a Postman Network listing.

request.description: A case remains $120 but shrinks from 12 to 10 units. Expected normalized unit cost rises from 10 to 12 (20%). New keys prevent conflicts, not duplicate billing: inspect any uncertain response before sending again.
